items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’m playing next weekend with Claude Terry [phonetic] in France

ctx.x: As far as the future goes, you’re still planning tours. You’re still planning recordings. Are there any particular things you’d like to accomplish or particular projects that you would want to work on?

Nothing I can think of. Well, I’m playing next weekend with Claude Terry [phonetic] in France and I’m looking forward to playing with Dizzy on his October cruise. And there are others, I mean, that I hope to play with again before I play with Gabriel. But no, I don’t have any . . . nothing outstanding.
